description: Main Loan Management System web application running on localhost:8080. Python-based application (likely Flask) with user authentication, profile management, and loan calculation features. Displays user information and allows loan detail queries through a web interface.
notes: Application requires authentication via /login. Default test credentials exist: test:test. Session tokens appear to be Flask session objects (base64 encoded with signature). Multiple security vulnerabilities identified including IDOR and weak authentication checks.
